:::{#def-deviation-pop-mean}
#### Deviation from a population or subpopulation mean (error, noise term)

The **deviation from the mean** of a [random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $Y$
is its [deviation](#def-deviation)
from its [expectation](expectation.qmd#def-expectation):

$$\devn(Y) \eqdef Y - \E{Y}$$

For a realized [observation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/exploratory-descriptive.html#def-observation) $y$:

$$\devn(y) \eqdef y - \E{Y}$$

:::
